description: Research ledger: each research task, its question, sources and conclusion.

session.description: Short id of the agent session that wrote the row.

verdict.description: The one-line answer the research reached (crew#227 added it, 2026-08-27).

kind.description: Row kind. Absent for research rows; 'idea' for a business idea from the research engine (crew#537 CP5, 2026-08-28).

forecast.description: Idea rows only: the author's probability in [0, 1] that the idea's question resolves yes; graded by science/showcase.py ideas() (crew#537).

outcome.description: Idea rows only: 0 or 1 once the question resolved; the Brier score is the mean squared error of forecast minus outcome (crew#537).
